Name: Fish Tank Kit
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35623/35623-1752329623-287803720.png[/img][/center]
This mod adds two kinds of fish tanks to the game, a free-standing one, and one designed to blend into a wall. They range in size from 2 tiles wide (1 fish) to 17 tiles wide (16 fish). In addition there are a set of caps, which are placed on the wall behind the wall-mounted versions to complete the illusion.

This mod was absolutely inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24922]Recessed Fish Tanks[/url], I just decided I wanted something similar which didn't rely on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]. That said, if you want a more versatile option that does something very similar, give them a look!

This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Mini-Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!
